# Component sheets

<!-- Generated by tools/components.py from components/catalogue.py and components/components.css. Do not hand-edit: edit those and run python3 tools/components.py. -->

41 components in 8 groups, as plain CSS in [components/components.css](../components/components.css) over the house roles and scales, with one script, [components/radiogroup.js](../components/radiogroup.js), for the segmented control's arrow keys.
Each sheet below is generated from the same entry as its rendered card, and its token list is read from the CSS rules that name the component's classes, so it cannot name a token the component does not use.
Where a sheet and an older card in [65-components.md](65-components.md) differ, the sheet is the later decision.

## The component layer

Load it after the faces and the variables a brand exports, and load the script once:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="fonts/fonts.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="exports/variables.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="components/components.css">
<script src="components/radiogroup.js" defer></script>
```

A product brand loads `examples/<brand>/exports/variables.css` in place of the house file and gets the same components in its own colour.
The layer names `hw-` properties and declares none of its own, except the `--_` locals a component sets on itself; a product extends in its own namespace.
Every size is in rem or em, so `html[data-text-size]` grows every box with its text, and `[data-density="compact"]`, `(pointer: coarse)`, `prefers-contrast: more` and `prefers-reduced-motion` reach every component through the variables it reads.
`forced-colors: active` redraws the checked and current states in system colours.

What the layer does not do: it positions nothing a product has to place (a toast's corner, a menu's anchor in an engine without anchor positioning), it captures no hotkey, and it moves focus only where a native element does.
Those are the product's, and each sheet's Keyboard line says which.

Open a group's page in a browser to see every state live, at any theme, text size, density or brand, with `?theme=dark`, `?text-size=xl`, `?density=compact` or `?brand=papertrace`.

## Print

Printing is a house surface, answered by one block at the end of the layer rather than by a component.
Under `@media print` the floating surfaces (tooltip, toast, menu, popover, sheet, scrim), the skeleton, the level meter and an indeterminate progress bar are removed; a dialog or a margin note keeps a 1px `--hw-line-strong` edge in place of its shadow; a stage prints as ink on paper inside that edge; marks, proof marks, diff rows, badges, pins and status dots keep their colour with `print-color-adjust: exact`; rows, table rows, callouts, notes and key-value pairs do not break across pages; and an external link prints its address after its text.

## Actions

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/actions.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/actions-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/actions-dark.webp).

### Button

- **For:** Starts an action whose verb is its label.
- **Not for:** Moving to another page (a link); choosing between options (segmented control).
- **Anatomy:** A box at least --hw-control-h tall in three sizes, 12px side padding at M, radius --hw-radius-md, a 13px label at weight 560, an optional icon at 1.15em with an 8px gap. Variants: secondary (the default), primary in ink, accent, quiet, danger outlined and danger solid, and icon-only.
- **States:** rest, hover (fill), active (1px press), focus-visible (2px ring at 2px offset), disabled (fill, disabled ink, no border), busy (a spinner before the label; still under reduced motion).
- **Keyboard:** A native button: Tab reaches it, Enter and Space press it. An icon-only button carries aria-label.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-duration-fast`, `--hw-ease-out`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** One primary per view, in ink. Keep the accent variant for a stage or the one brand moment a product names.
- **Do not:** Two primaries side by side. Colour a button to make it louder. Disable a submit because a form is incomplete.
- **Classes:** `.hw-btn`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: rem sizing, accent variant added, padding derived from height.
- **Used by:** all four.

### Link

- **For:** Moves the reader somewhere else; underlined, so it never relies on colour.
- **Not for:** Starting an action in place (a button).
- **Anatomy:** Inline text in --hw-accent-text with a 1px underline at 0.18em offset, 2px under the pointer. In print an external link prints its address after it.
- **States:** rest, hover, focus-visible; visited is left unstyled because tools are revisited.
- **Keyboard:** A native anchor: Tab reaches it, Enter follows it.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-accent-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-xs`.
- **Do:** Write the destination as the link text.
- **Do not:** Write 'click here'. Remove the underline in running text.
- **Classes:** `.hw-link`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** the house.

### Keycap

- **For:** Names a key or a shortcut the person presses.
- **Not for:** Code (the code mark); a pressable control (a button).
- **Anatomy:** Mono at 0.8em and never under 11px, a 1px --hw-line-strong border with a 2px bottom edge, radius --hw-radius-sm, on --hw-surface.
- **States:** static.
- **Keyboard:** Not focusable: it names a key, it is not one.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-font-mono`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`.
- **Do:** Use the platform's symbols: ⌘ ⌥ ⇧ ⌃.
- **Do not:** Spell out 'Cmd'. Use it as a pressable control.
- **Classes:** `.hw-kbd`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: quoth hand-rolls it; the house had no entry.
- **Used by:** quoth, pointback.

### Segmented control

- **For:** Chooses one of two to five mutually exclusive views or values in place.
- **Not for:** Moving between pages (tabs, rail); more than five options (select).
- **Anatomy:** A track on --hw-fill with a 2px inset; the selected segment sits on --hw-surface with a 1px --hw-line-strong edge. Segments wrap rather than overflow at large text sizes.
- **States:** rest, hover, selected, focus-visible, disabled.
- **Keyboard:** A radio group: one Tab stop on the selected segment, arrow keys move the choice, Home and End jump to the ends, disabled segments are skipped. components/radiogroup.js is the whole script.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-focus-offset`, `--hw-focus-w`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Label every segment with a word.
- **Do not:** Use icons alone. Animate the selection sliding.
- **Classes:** `.hw-segmented`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep anatomy, rem sizing.
- **Used by:** the house.

## Inputs

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/inputs.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/inputs-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/inputs-dark.webp).

### Text field

- **For:** Takes a short typed value.
- **Not for:** Long text (textarea); picking from a known list (select).
- **Anatomy:** A 13px/560 label above at 4px; the box at least --hw-control-h with --hw-field-pad-y and --hw-field-pad-x inside, a 1px --hw-line-strong edge (3:1), radius --hw-radius-md; a hint or an error sentence below at 12px.
- **States:** rest, hover (edge to muted), focus-visible (edge and inset ring), invalid (danger edge plus an error sentence with an icon), disabled, read-only (dashed edge on --hw-bg-subtle).
- **Keyboard:** Native input; the label is a real label, and the error is tied with aria-describedby.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-bg-subtle`, `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-danger`, `--hw-field-pad-x`, `--hw-field-pad-y`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`, `--hw-text-xs`.
- **Do:** Say what is wrong and what is expected in the error.
- **Do not:** Use the placeholder as the label. Turn the edge red without a sentence.
- **Classes:** `.hw-field`, `.hw-field-label`, `.hw-field-hint`, `.hw-field-error`, `.hw-input`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: hint and error under the field, rem height.
- **Used by:** all four.

### Textarea

- **For:** Takes several lines of text.
- **Not for:** One line (text field).
- **Anatomy:** As the text field, at least three lines tall, resizing vertically only.
- **States:** as the text field.
- **Keyboard:** Native textarea; Tab leaves it, so it never traps focus.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-bg-subtle`, `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-danger`, `--hw-field-pad-x`, `--hw-field-pad-y`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-leading`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Show a count only when there is a limit.
- **Do not:** Grow without a maximum.
- **Classes:** `.hw-textarea`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** pointback.

### Select

- **For:** Picks one value from a list the platform can show natively.
- **Not for:** Fewer than three options (segmented control).
- **Anatomy:** The text field box with a drawn chevron in --hw-text-muted; the list itself is the platform's.
- **States:** as the text field.
- **Keyboard:** Native select: arrow keys change the value, and the platform's own list opens on Space.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-danger`, `--hw-field-pad-x`, `--hw-field-pad-y`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Keep it native: it is accessible for free.
- **Do not:** Rebuild the list in a script to restyle it.
- **Classes:** `.hw-select`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep: native by default.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Search field

- **For:** Filters what is on the screen as the person types.
- **Not for:** Submitting a query to a server page (a form).
- **Anatomy:** The text field with a leading magnifier at 1.15em; the label is visually hidden and says what is searched.
- **States:** as the text field.
- **Keyboard:** Native input of type search; Escape clears it in every engine.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-field-pad-x`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Say what is searched: 'Search your words'.
- **Do not:** Write 'Search...'.
- **Classes:** `.hw-search`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** quoth, papertrace.

### Checkbox and radio

- **For:** Checkbox: an independent yes or no, or several of a set. Radio: one of a small set, all visible.
- **Not for:** A setting that applies at once (switch).
- **Anatomy:** A 1.15em box with a 1px --hw-line-strong edge; checked fills --hw-ink with an --hw-on-ink mark; the 13px label beside it, and the whole row is the target.
- **States:** unchecked, checked, indeterminate, focus-visible, disabled; under forced colours the checked box takes Highlight.
- **Keyboard:** Native inputs: Space toggles a checkbox; radios in one name are one Tab stop with arrow keys.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-focus-offset`, `--hw-focus-w`, `--hw-ink`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-on-ink`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Write the label as the thing that becomes true.
- **Do not:** Use a checkbox for a setting that applies at once.
- **Classes:** `.hw-check`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep: ink when checked.
- **Used by:** the house.

### Switch

- **For:** Turns a setting on or off, effective at once.
- **Not for:** A choice that waits for a Save (checkbox).
- **Anatomy:** A track 2.13em by 1.2em with the thumb inset; on is --hw-ink. The label sits before it in a settings row.
- **States:** off, on, focus-visible, disabled.
- **Keyboard:** A native checkbox with role switch: Space toggles it.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-duration-fast`, `--hw-ease-out`, `--hw-fill-active`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-focus-offset`, `--hw-focus-w`, `--hw-ink`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-on-ink`, `--hw-radius-full`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Name the setting, not the state.
- **Do not:** Write 'Enabled' as the label.
- **Classes:** `.hw-switch`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Slider

- **For:** Sets a value on a continuous range where the exact number matters less than the feel.
- **Not for:** A precise number (a text field).
- **Anatomy:** A track 0.27em tall with the ink fill reaching the thumb's centre (the page sets --_p to the value's fraction of the range), a 1.07em thumb with a 2px ink ring; the value printed beside it.
- **States:** rest, focus-visible, disabled.
- **Keyboard:** Native range input: arrow keys step it, Home and End jump to the ends.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-fill-active`, `--hw-ink`, `--hw-radius-full`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-surface`.
- **Do:** Print the value with its unit.
- **Do not:** Hide the value.
- **Classes:** `.hw-slider`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Hotkey field

- **For:** Shows the shortcut that starts something, and records a new one when pressed.
- **Not for:** Typing text (a text field); naming a key in prose (a keycap).
- **Anatomy:** The text field box as a button, holding the current shortcut as keycaps. While recording it is pressed, with a focus-coloured inset edge and a muted prompt; a clash shows the field error below it.
- **States:** set, recording (aria-pressed), invalid (a clash, with a sentence), disabled.
- **Keyboard:** A native button: Enter or Space starts recording, the next chord is taken, Escape cancels. Capturing the chord is the product's script; this layer draws the states.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-danger`, `--hw-field-pad-x`, `--hw-field-pad-y`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Show the shortcut in the platform's symbols, as the menu bar will.
- **Do not:** Accept a chord the system already owns without saying so.
- **Classes:** `.hw-hotkey`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: quoth records a shortcut and the house had no anatomy for one.
- **Used by:** quoth.

## Feedback and status

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/feedback.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/feedback-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/feedback-dark.webp).

### Badge and status

- **For:** Badge: a short state word on a row. Status: a dot and a word for a live condition.
- **Not for:** Counts on navigation; a state without a word.
- **Anatomy:** Badge: 12px/600 on its state fill with a 0.45em dot, radius --hw-radius-sm. Status: a 0.6em dot in the state's step-9 solid, the word in text colour beside it.
- **States:** neutral, accent, success, warning, danger.
- **Keyboard:** Not focusable; the word is the accessible text.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-fill`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`, `--hw-text-xs`.
- **Do:** Always a word beside the colour.
- **Do not:** Colour alone. A badge that says 'New'.
- **Classes:** `.hw-badge`, `.hw-status`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: status dot added for live states.
- **Used by:** all four.

### Callout

- **For:** Says one thing the reader must know before acting on this view.
- **Not for:** A transient confirmation (toast); an error on one field (field error).
- **Anatomy:** An icon, a bold first phrase, at most three lines, optional actions; the state fill with a 1px state line on all four sides.
- **States:** neutral, success, warning, danger.
- **Keyboard:** Its actions are ordinary buttons in reading order after the text.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-leading`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-16`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Lead with what happened, then where the work is, then the one action.
- **Do not:** A coloured left stripe. More than one callout per view.
- **Classes:** `.hw-callout`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: neutral kind added, no left stripe.
- **Used by:** quoth, papertrace.

### Toast

- **For:** Confirms an action finished, with an Undo when the action can be undone.
- **Not for:** Errors that need action (callout); anything the person must read twice.
- **Anatomy:** An ink surface at radius --hw-radius-lg and at least --hw-row-h tall, 13px text, an optional outlined action; bottom centre, one at a time, 5 seconds, paused on hover and on focus.
- **States:** enter (200ms rise, a fade only under reduced motion), exit.
- **Keyboard:** role status, so it is announced without taking focus; its Undo is reachable by Tab.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-ink`, `--hw-ink-hover`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-on-ink`, `--hw-radius-lg`, `--hw-row-h`, `--hw-shadow-overlay`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-16`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Name the result: 'Copied'. Offer Undo for a delete.
- **Do not:** Stack three. Put an error in a toast.
- **Classes:** `.hw-toast`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: ink surface, so it reads as transient in both themes.
- **Used by:** quoth, pointback.

### Progress

- **For:** Shows how far a known task has gone; indeterminate only when the total is unknown.
- **Not for:** A live level (level meter).
- **Anatomy:** A 0.27rem track on --hw-fill-active with an ink fill and full radius; a sentence with the numbers beside it.
- **States:** determinate, indeterminate (sweeps; under reduced motion a still full-width bar at 35% opacity).
- **Keyboard:** role progressbar with aria-valuenow, or no value when indeterminate; not focusable.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-duration-base`, `--hw-ease-out`, `--hw-fill-active`, `--hw-ink`, `--hw-radius-full`.
- **Do:** Print what and how much: '86 of 148 MB'.
- **Do not:** A percentage with no unit of work.
- **Classes:** `.hw-progress`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: absorbs the partial row; the house had a permission and no anatomy.
- **Used by:** quoth, papertrace.

### Skeleton

- **For:** Holds the shape of content that takes more than 300ms to arrive.
- **Not for:** Content that loads at once; a spinner in a list.
- **Anatomy:** Bars on --hw-fill-active at text height and the expected width; no shimmer.
- **States:** static.
- **Keyboard:** Hidden from assistive technology; the container says it is busy with aria-busy.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-fill-active`, `--hw-radius-sm`.
- **Do:** Match the width of what will arrive.
- **Do not:** Shimmer.
- **Classes:** `.hw-skeleton`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** the house.

### Level meter

- **For:** Shows a live input level; the only thing in the house that moves on its own.
- **Not for:** Progress; decoration.
- **Anatomy:** Bars 0.2em wide and 0.13em apart on --hw-fill-active; lit bars take the product's live colour through --_live (quoth sets --hw-live-9). Always beside a word.
- **States:** idle, live (bars follow the input; under reduced motion they still follow it and nothing else moves).
- **Keyboard:** aria-hidden: the word beside it carries the state.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-accent`, `--hw-fill-active`.
- **Do:** Pair it with 'Listening'.
- **Do not:** Animate it when no audio arrives.
- **Classes:** `.hw-meter`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: the house excluded a meter while quoth ships one.
- **Used by:** quoth.

## Overlays

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/overlays.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/overlays-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/overlays-dark.webp).

### Menu

- **For:** Lists actions on a thing, opened from a button or a secondary click.
- **Not for:** Picking a value (select); navigation (rail).
- **Anatomy:** A raised surface with a 4px inset; items at control height minus 2px with a 1.15em icon and the shortcut right-aligned in muted; a 1px separator; the destructive item last, in danger.
- **States:** item rest, active (fill), checked (tick), disabled, destructive.
- **Keyboard:** Opened as a popover from its button, so Escape and an outside click close it and focus returns. Items are buttons in a column: Tab moves through them. Arrow-key roving is the product's.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-fill-hover`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-radius-lg`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-shadow-overlay`, `--hw-space-16`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-surface-raised`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-disabled`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`, `--hw-text-xs`, `--hw-z-dropdown`.
- **Do:** Put the destructive item last, after a separator.
- **Do not:** Nest more than one level.
- **Classes:** `.hw-menu`, `.hw-menu-item`, `.hw-menu-key`, `.hw-menu-sep`, `.hw-menu-label`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: absorbs the partial row (item height, separator and destructive rule).
- **Used by:** quoth, pointback.

### Tooltip

- **For:** Names an icon-only control and its shortcut.
- **Not for:** Anything the person needs in order to act: it is unreachable on touch.
- **Anatomy:** An ink box, 12px/500, at most 18rem wide, radius --hw-radius-sm, 8px from its control. Wrap the control in .hw-tip; it shows above, or below with .hw-tip--below.
- **States:** hidden; shown 500ms after hover or keyboard focus of the control, hidden at once.
- **Keyboard:** Shown on focus as well as hover, from CSS alone. The control keeps its own aria-label; the tip repeats it for sighted readers.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-duration-fast`, `--hw-ease-out`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-ink`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-on-ink`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text-xs`, `--hw-z-dropdown`.
- **Do:** Show it on focus as well as hover.
- **Do not:** Put a sentence of help in it.
- **Classes:** `.hw-tip`, `.hw-tooltip`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: absorbs the partial row (delay, placement and width).
- **Used by:** all four.

### Popover

- **For:** Shows a small panel of detail or controls tied to one thing on screen.
- **Not for:** A task with its own flow (dialog).
- **Anatomy:** A raised surface, 16px padding, 20rem wide, --hw-shadow-overlay; opens below its anchor and flips above or across at the edge, where the engine supports anchor positioning.
- **States:** closed, open.
- **Keyboard:** The popover attribute and popovertarget: no script, Escape and an outside click close it, and focus returns to the button.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-leading`, `--hw-radius-lg`, `--hw-shadow-overlay`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-16`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-surface-raised`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Use the popover attribute so it escapes overflow.
- **Do not:** Position it absolutely inside a scrolling list.
- **Classes:** `.hw-popover`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: absorbs the partial row, generalised from the combobox popover.
- **Used by:** quoth, pointback.

### Dialog

- **For:** Asks for a decision that blocks the task until it is answered.
- **Not for:** Information (callout); a confirmation that fits its row (inline confirm).
- **Anatomy:** A raised surface at radius --hw-radius-lg, 24px padding, a 21px title, the body, actions right with the primary last; the scrim behind.
- **States:** open (320ms rise, none under reduced motion), closing.
- **Keyboard:** A native dialog opened with showModal or a command button: focus moves in, is held there, and returns on close; Escape closes it.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-duration-slow`, `--hw-ease-out`, `--hw-leading`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-lg`, `--hw-scrim`, `--hw-shadow-dialog`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-24`, `--hw-surface-raised`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Write the title as the question and the button as the answer.
- **Do not:** 'Are you sure?' with OK and Cancel.
- **Classes:** `.hw-dialog`, `.hw-scrim`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep: actions right-aligned, primary last.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Sheet

- **For:** Holds a secondary task beside the page it belongs to, such as a setting's detail or a record's history, without leaving the page.
- **Not for:** A decision that blocks (dialog); the app's own navigation (rail).
- **Anatomy:** A dialog anchored to the inline end, full height, 26rem wide at most and the full width below that, radius --hw-radius-lg on its open edge; a head with the title and a close button, a body that scrolls, and actions at the foot.
- **States:** open (slides in over 320ms; appears in place under reduced motion), closing.
- **Keyboard:** A native dialog opened modally: focus moves to its first control, is held, and returns on close; Escape closes it.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-duration-slow`, `--hw-ease-out`, `--hw-leading`, `--hw-radius-lg`, `--hw-scrim`, `--hw-shadow-dialog`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-24`, `--hw-surface-raised`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Keep the page it belongs to visible behind the scrim.
- **Do not:** Open a sheet from a sheet.
- **Classes:** `.hw-sheet`, `.hw-sheet-head`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: a general sheet was ruled out while quoth ships one.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Inline confirm

- **For:** Confirms a destructive action on one row without leaving it.
- **Not for:** Bulk or irreversible deletes of many things (dialog).
- **Anatomy:** Replaces the row's actions at the row's height: a sentence, the danger button, Cancel. It wraps rather than overflows at large text sizes.
- **States:** open; it never times out.
- **Keyboard:** Focus moves to Cancel when it opens and returns to the row's action when it closes.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-row-h`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Repeat the verb on the button.
- **Do not:** Time it out.
- **Classes:** `.hw-confirm`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** quoth.

## Navigation

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/navigation.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/navigation-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/navigation-dark.webp).

### Rail and navigation item

- **For:** Moves between the four to six places of an app.
- **Not for:** Actions (buttons); sections within a page (tabs).
- **Anatomy:** The rail on --hw-bg-subtle; items at control height with a 1.15em icon, a 13px label and the shortcut right; the current item sits on --hw-surface with a 1px --hw-line-strong edge.
- **States:** rest, hover, current (aria-current page), focus-visible.
- **Keyboard:** Links in a nav landmark, in order; the shortcut is the product's.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-bg-subtle`, `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-fill`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-space-16`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`, `--hw-text-xs`.
- **Do:** Show the shortcut beside each item.
- **Do not:** Badges or counts on the rail.
- **Classes:** `.hw-rail`, `.hw-nav-item`, `.hw-nav-key`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: the current item is a surface, not an accent fill.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Tabs

- **For:** Switches between views of the same thing.
- **Not for:** Moving between places (rail); filtering (segmented control).
- **Anatomy:** 13px labels 16px apart on a 1px line, each at control height; the active tab has a 2px rule in --hw-text and weight 620; a count may follow in muted. Tabs wrap at large text sizes.
- **States:** rest, hover, selected, focus-visible.
- **Keyboard:** The layer styles role tab; the product owns the panels and the arrow-key roving between tabs, since the panels are its own.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-space-16`, `--hw-tab-active-w`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Keep to three to six.
- **Do not:** Colour the active tab.
- **Classes:** `.hw-tabs`, `.hw-tab`, `.hw-tab-count`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: active rule in text colour, not accent.
- **Used by:** papertrace, pointback.

### Toolbar

- **For:** Groups the actions for the current view.
- **Not for:** Navigation.
- **Anatomy:** A row of controls 8px apart within a group, a further 8px spacer between groups; it wraps rather than clips, and its overflow goes into a menu.
- **States:** as its buttons.
- **Keyboard:** role toolbar with an aria-label; its buttons are Tab stops in order.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-space-8`.
- **Do:** Order by frequency.
- **Do not:** Icon-only buttons without tooltips.
- **Classes:** `.hw-toolbar`, `.hw-toolbar-sep`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** the house.

## Data display

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/data.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/data-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/data-dark.webp).

### List row

- **For:** One record in a list scanned for a single subject.
- **Not for:** Comparing values across records (table).
- **Anatomy:** A grid of time, content and source; --hw-cell-pad-y and 12px padding; a 1px --hw-line between rows; at least --hw-row-h tall; a selected row becomes a bordered surface holding its actions.
- **States:** rest, hover, selected (expanded), focus-visible.
- **Keyboard:** The row's own control, usually its content as a button, is the Tab stop; its actions follow it only when it is selected.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-bg-subtle`, `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-cell-pad-y`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-row-h`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-md`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Show actions on the selected row only.
- **Do not:** A card per row; four icon buttons on every row.
- **Classes:** `.hw-list`, `.hw-row`, `.hw-row-meta`, `.hw-row-actions`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: hover tint, the selected row opens in place.
- **Used by:** quoth, pointback.

### Table

- **For:** Compares values across records.
- **Not for:** Scanning for one subject (list row).
- **Anatomy:** A 12px/560 muted head over a 1px --hw-line-strong rule; 13px cells with 12px side padding; numbers right-aligned and tabular; no zebra, no vertical rules.
- **States:** rest, hover, sorted (head in text colour, aria-sort), selected (accent fill).
- **Keyboard:** A native table; a sortable head is a button inside the th.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-accent-fill`, `--hw-bg-subtle`, `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-cell-pad-y`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`, `--hw-text-xs`.
- **Do:** Right-align numbers with tabular figures.
- **Do not:** Centre text columns.
- **Classes:** `.hw-table`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: 12px cells, against the 9px the house once wrote.
- **Used by:** papertrace.

### Key-value list

- **For:** Shows the properties of one thing.
- **Not for:** Many things (table).
- **Anatomy:** Two columns, keys muted at 13px and values in text; an 8px row gap and a 24px column gap; it stacks in a container narrower than 30rem.
- **States:** set, missing (the value reads 'Not set').
- **Keyboard:** A native description list; not focusable.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-space-24`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Write units into the value.
- **Do not:** An empty dash for a missing value.
- **Classes:** `.hw-kv`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** all four.

### Empty state

- **For:** Says what will appear here and how to make it appear.
- **Not for:** An error (callout).
- **Anatomy:** A 2.67rem glyph in muted, a 17px sentence, a 13px line with the key or the action; aligned with the content column.
- **States:** nothing yet, nothing found, nothing permitted.
- **Keyboard:** Its one action, when it has one, is the first Tab stop in the container.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-space-48`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`.
- **Do:** Teach the one action.
- **Do not:** A mascot. 'No data'.
- **Classes:** `.hw-empty`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** rework: left-aligned with the column, one glyph at most.
- **Used by:** quoth, pointback.

### Stat

- **For:** A number the person comes back to check.
- **Not for:** Decoration on a dashboard.
- **Anatomy:** The value at 21px/650 in tabular figures, the label at 12px muted under it, the unit in the value.
- **States:** static.
- **Keyboard:** Not focusable; the label follows the value in reading order.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-leading-tight`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-xl`.
- **Do:** Say over what period or of what.
- **Do not:** The hero-metric template with a gradient.
- **Classes:** `.hw-stat`, `.hw-stat-value`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new.
- **Used by:** quoth, papertrace.

### Tag

- **For:** A word or short value from a set, often the product's own vocabulary.
- **Not for:** A state (badge).
- **Anatomy:** An inline box at least 1.6rem tall, 13px/500, on --hw-mark-quiet, radius --hw-radius-sm; a removable tag ends in a small button.
- **States:** rest, removable.
- **Keyboard:** Only the remove button is a Tab stop, named 'Remove' and the word.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-fill-hover`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-focus-offset`, `--hw-focus-w`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-mark-quiet`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Show the real word as the product will type it.
- **Do not:** Colour-code tags by category.
- **Classes:** `.hw-tag`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: quoth's vocabulary chips are hand-rolled.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Disclosure

- **For:** Hides detail most readers do not need.
- **Not for:** Primary content.
- **Anatomy:** A summary row at --hw-row-h with a chevron that turns in 120ms; the content below.
- **States:** closed, open, focus-visible.
- **Keyboard:** A native details element: Enter or Space on the summary opens it.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-control-h`, `--hw-duration-fast`, `--hw-ease-out`, `--hw-focus`, `--hw-focus-offset`, `--hw-focus-w`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-leading-snug`, `--hw-row-h`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Write the summary as what is inside.
- **Do not:** Nest them.
- **Classes:** `.hw-disclosure`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** papertrace.

### Avatar

- **For:** Stands for a person beside what they did: who left a note, who sent a review.
- **Not for:** A product mark; decoration.
- **Anatomy:** A circle at --hw-radius-full in three sizes (1.6, 1.87 and 2.67rem), initials at 40% of its size on --hw-fill-active, never under 11px; an image covers the initials once it loads; a group overlaps by 0.4rem with a 2px ring in --hw-surface.
- **States:** initials, image, group.
- **Keyboard:** Not focusable; the image's alt or an aria-label carries the name, and a group's count is text.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-fill-active`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-radius-full`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`.
- **Do:** Keep the initials under the image, so a failed load still names the person.
- **Do not:** Stack more than four; say '+3' as text after them.
- **Classes:** `.hw-avatar`, `.hw-avatar-group`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: absorbs the partial row (sizes, fallback initials and the group).
- **Used by:** pointback.

## Marks, the house signature

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/marks.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/marks-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/marks-dark.webp).

### Highlight

- **For:** Marks the words a product knows, matched or pointed at.
- **Not for:** Emphasis in prose (use weight); a state.
- **Anatomy:** Light: a highlighter swipe from 44% to 90% of the line box in --hw-mark, the text left in ink. Dark: a block in mark step 7 with the text in --hw-text, since a swipe under light text measured 1.15:1; the bright solid (.hw-mark--solid) is kept for the one selected word.
- **States:** rest, solid (the selected word), quiet (--hw-mark-quiet, for dense lists).
- **Keyboard:** Not focusable unless the product makes the word a button that explains the mark.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-mark`, `--hw-mark-7`, `--hw-mark-quiet`, `--hw-on-mark`, `--hw-text`.
- **Do:** Mark only what the product can explain on click.
- **Do not:** Highlight a whole paragraph. Use it as the selection colour.
- **Classes:** `.hw-mark`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: the house signature; quoth's report asked for the ink-on-highlight pair.
- **Used by:** all three apps.

### Proof marks

- **For:** Shows what a product changed in someone's words, the way an editor marks a page.
- **Not for:** Code changes (diff).
- **Anatomy:** The original words in muted; removed words struck through in --hw-delete; inserted text in --hw-insert, bold, on its fill, with a caret under the line at the point of insertion.
- **States:** static.
- **Keyboard:** Use ins and del elements, so the change is announced as well as drawn.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-delete`, `--hw-insert`, `--hw-insert-fill`, `--hw-text-md`, `--hw-text-muted`.
- **Do:** Show the person's own words, then the result.
- **Do not:** Rely on colour alone: the strike and the caret carry it.
- **Classes:** `.hw-proof`, `.hw-ins`, `.hw-del`, `.hw-caret`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: quoth's Show changes needs it; papertrace and pointback show diffs.
- **Used by:** quoth.

### Diff

- **For:** Shows changed lines of code or text with their context.
- **Not for:** Changes inside prose (proof marks).
- **Anatomy:** Mono 13px, a line per row; added rows on --hw-insert-fill with a + in --hw-insert, removed rows on --hw-delete-fill with a minus in --hw-delete; the text stays ink. It scrolls sideways rather than overflow its box.
- **States:** static.
- **Keyboard:** Not focusable unless it scrolls; the signs are text, so a screen reader reads them.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-delete`, `--hw-delete-fill`, `--hw-font-mono`, `--hw-insert`, `--hw-insert-fill`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-radius-md`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Keep the text in ink; the fill and the sign carry the change.
- **Do not:** Colour the text green and red.
- **Classes:** `.hw-diff`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new.
- **Used by:** pointback, papertrace.

### Pin and margin note

- **For:** Points at a place on a page and carries a note back.
- **Not for:** Decoration.
- **Anatomy:** A 1.6rem teardrop in the product's solid with its number; the note is a card beside it with the selector in mono, truncated to one line.
- **States:** placed, sent, resolved.
- **Keyboard:** The note is the Tab stop; the pin is its label, read with it.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-accent`, `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-font-sans`, `--hw-leading`, `--hw-line`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-on-accent`, `--hw-radius-lg`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-4`, `--hw-surface`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-muted`, `--hw-text-sm`, `--hw-text-xs`.
- **Do:** Number pins in the order they were made.
- **Do not:** Hide the number.
- **Classes:** `.hw-pin`, `.hw-note`, `.hw-note-locator`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: pointback's mark, generalised.
- **Used by:** pointback.

### Code

- **For:** Inline code, identifiers and commands as typed.
- **Not for:** Keys (keycap).
- **Anatomy:** Mono at 0.92em on --hw-fill, radius --hw-radius-sm; a block is 13px with 8px and 12px padding and scrolls sideways.
- **States:** static.
- **Keyboard:** A code element; a block that scrolls is focusable so the keyboard can scroll it.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-fill`, `--hw-font-mono`, `--hw-leading`, `--hw-radius-sm`, `--hw-space-12`, `--hw-space-8`, `--hw-text`, `--hw-text-sm`.
- **Do:** Show the identifier exactly as it is written.
- **Do not:** Syntax-colour a one-line command.
- **Classes:** `.hw-code`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** keep.
- **Used by:** all four.

## Stage

Rendered: [the live page](../components/sheets/stage.html), and at M, [light](../components/renders/stage-light.webp) and [dark](../components/renders/stage-dark.webp).

### Stage

- **For:** The one loud surface a product may have: a welcome, a site section, a store frame, an empty state at most once.
- **Not for:** Any working view: lists, settings, reports. quoth's welcome, which stays on paper.
- **Anatomy:** A full field in the highlighter solid, the product's accent or ink, radius --hw-radius-lg or full bleed, display type at the stage sizes, at most one action and one drawing.
- **States:** static; one entry moment, none under reduced motion.
- **Keyboard:** Its one action is an ordinary button or link; the focus ring takes the stage's own text colour.
- **Tokens:** `--hw-border-w`, `--hw-line-strong`, `--hw-mark`, `--hw-on-mark`, `--hw-radius-lg`, `--hw-space-24`, `--hw-space-64`, `--hw-text`.
- **Do:** Put the person's real words or the product's real output on it.
- **Do not:** Gradients, glow, sparkles, a stock illustration.
- **Classes:** `.hw-stage`.
- **Against the house before this layer:** new: replaces the 'vivid field' rule with a component and a place.
- **Used by:** site, store frames.
